'''Zero-G Assault Stormtrooper Armor Mark I''' was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper]]s. Designed by scientist [[Nashiak Llalik]]<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>, it was a powered armor with integrated life support systems for deep-[[Realspace/Legends|space]] operations and combat. Operators entered from a hatch on the back of the armor, stirring in a saddle inside the armor and secured with an internal harness and foot stirrups. The armor was intended for use by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in full armor; operation of the suit without [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]] was awkward but not impossible.<ref name="ISB" />

The helmet incorporated an inbuilt [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], suit status board, and a viewscreen that showed a view of the area behind the spacetrooper. The armor's chest included an integrated tactical display and active [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] package, link to torso mounted sensor units and arrays. The torso also held an extended range comlink.<ref name="ISB" />

The armor's backpack was fitted with two [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launchers]], along with storage magazines for the ammunition, including [[Gas grenade/Legends|gas]], [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun]], and [[Concussion grenade/Legends|concussion grenades]]. A communications antenna was mounted on the backpack, along with a [[Fire extinguisher/Legends|fire extinguisher]], environmental control apparatus, two lights positioned on the shoulders, and the armor's main [[repulsorlift propulsion unit]].<ref name="ISB" />

A [[Laser cutter/Legends|laser cutter]] and [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] was mounted on the armor's right forearm, and a miniature [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|proton torpedo hurler]] on the left. Each arm terminated in a three fingered gripper, which had the option to retract up the wrist to reveal an iris that allowed the stormtrooper's hand to emerge from the suit.<ref name="ISB" />

The suit's legs mounted the attitude control thrusters, and well as foot mounted auxiliary repulsorlift propulsion units. Foot pedals controlled the RPUs and the armor's [[Magnetic coupler/Legends|magnetic couplers]]. A toggle mounted at shin level moved the stirrup into and out of attitude thruster control, and the suit's recharging couplers and breathing gas life support were housed in the feet.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>

A newer version of the Zero-G Armor, named [[Zero-G Assault Stormtrooper Armor Mark II]], was used by Spacetroopers during the [[Battle of Sluis Van]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="TTS">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>
